title: Expose read-only public catalog endpoint
requirements: Implement GET /api/v1/public/catalog as a read-only stable DTO from active services/options and club_settings.

Expose only accepted public fields: catalog_version, club_timezone, contact_info, location_link, visit_rules, services and options; never expose inactive or hidden options, PII, administrative or technical fields.
Cover fixed and negotiated pricing, empty/incomplete catalog behavior, privacy and no-write semantics with API and PostgreSQL integration tests.
acceptance: Configured PostgreSQL-backed catalog returns only active catalogue data in the docs/api.md envelope and stable DTO.
Missing settings or incomplete catalogue returns a deterministic safe error without writes.
Focused API, PostgreSQL integration, scope and whitespace validation pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: User-authorized read-only public catalog vertical slice; no new business or database contract.
